animations.carried: sneaky walk while carried: tiptoes in the air and glances side to side, in on the heist, never struggling
animations.denIdle: happy idle in the den: its eye looks around slowly, then stares straight at the camera
animations.stolen: gotcha pose when stolen: a quick enigmatic gotcha, in on the joke, never sad or scared

look: a creature from another world with a cat-like silhouette made of living night sky: its body is a deep starfield with drifting nebula wisps, its ears trail off into smoke, and one single huge crescent-moon eye sits in the center of its face and it has no other eyes, with a halo of tiny orbiting stars
name: The Midnight Mew
pose: floating in the air a little above the ground, its body tapering away instead of legs, nothing touching the ground
